facts.text: Reggie got out and I got in trouble. Dinner's on him this time, and I'm ordering the dearest thing on the menu.
facts.why: Not a Jack Cates line. The quote page has Cates saying things like 'I'm a cop, you're a crook.' and nothing about dinner. In the film Reggie wants his $500,000 back. Printed in quote marks and signed Jack Cates.
facts.fix: I'm a cop, you're a crook.

fix_note.text: I'm a cop, you're a crook.

facts.text: Serve dinner when the prison bus crashes.
facts.why: Wikipedia says the bus carrying Reggie is attacked by the two bikers, after Jack is shot at the diner. It does not say the bus crashes.
facts.fix: Serve dinner when the bikers attack the prison bus.

facts.text: Eaten on the stakeout in the car.
facts.why: The plot summary has no stakeout scene, so the note is not confirmed.
facts.fix: Eaten at the Hunter's Point Raceway, before the shooting starts.

facts.text: Reggie's first meal out, ordered on Jack's tab.
facts.why: Reggie is released, but no source shows a first meal or Jack paying for it.
facts.fix: Reggie's first meal out. Jack still owes him $500,000.

facts.text: Reggie's first stop out, Jack paying.
facts.why: Same problem: no source shows Reggie's first stop or Jack paying.
facts.fix: Reggie's first drink out. Jack still owes him.

vibe.verdict: Generic cop cafe that leaves out almost everything the sequel is remembered for.
missing: Reggie's stolen lighter, the gag that ends the film
Hunter's Point Raceway shootout that opens it
The Bird Cage nightclub finale in North Beach
The Ice Man turning out to be Ben Kehoe
Cherry Ganz and Willie Hickok, the biker hitmen
ideas: Swap the 'Second Furlough' stamp card for 'Jack's lighter', stamped each time Reggie steals it back.
Swap 'Glovebox jerky' for 'Raceway hot dog', tied to the Hunter's Point opening.
Swap 'Biker bar pickled eggs' note for 'Cherry and Hickok are waiting outside.'
Rename the 'Reggie's Release Day Counter' venue to 'The Bird Cage, North Beach' to use the film's real finale.
